about: Classification of every error-severity finding on the real-mod corpus, engine path and editor path (scripts/corpus-acceptance.js and the extension's corpus suite merge it into <slug>.counts.json; the first matching rule wins; mod '*' = any mod). real-defect = the script is wrong against CK3 1.20.0.2 and the game reports it; false-positive = the tool is wrong, tracked by the GitHub issue. Explained in FINDINGS.md.

rules.reason: VIET_misc_effects.txt:307 calls ek_character_setup_effect, defined neither by the mod nor by the 1.20.0.2 base game (an Elder Kings compatibility hook)

the mod folder name 'viet-events' matches the events/ directory pattern, so the mod's own scripted effects are indexed as events (issue #90); the same files in a folder named mod2227658180 report only the ek_character_setup_effect error
the mod folder name 'viet-events' matches the events/ directory pattern, so the mod's own scripted triggers are indexed as events (issue #90)
history/titles calls destroy_landless_title_no_dlc_effect, which the 1.20.0.2 base game no longer defines (no destroy_landless_title* name exists in game/common or game/history)
history/titles calls destroy_landless_title_no_tgp_dlc_effect, which the 1.20.0.2 base game no longer defines
an override of a vanilla scheme file still calls the pre-1.20 name; 1.20.0.2 defines trait_is_shunned_or_criminal_in_rite_trigger (faith -> rite)

the trigger is is_widgetid_open in 1.20.0.2 (game/common/trigger_localization/00_debug_triggers.txt: 'is_widgetid_open ... re-uses the old is_widget_open localization'); the spec package has is_widgetid_open
the file ends with an unmatched closing brace (brace depth goes negative on its last line, 661)
the modifier was renamed in 1.20.0.2 (rite_creation_piety_cost_mult, used by the base game's buildings); RICE declares supported_version 1.19.*
modifier names are case-sensitive; the character modifier is fertility, 'Fertility' is not a modifier type
<character link> = <character> is the ordinary comparison form; the 1.20.0.2 base game writes it 1,475 times (issue #91)
trigger = { always = no } disables content on purpose; the base game writes it 167 times and the game reports nothing (issue #92)
colour values rgb { } / hsv { } read as scripted effect calls (issue #93)
colour values rgb { } / hsv { } read as scripted trigger calls (issue #93)
every key ending in _portrait is checked (gfx accessories and cameras, a decision name) and highlight_portrait is not known (issue #94)
triggered_desc triggers are evaluated when the window is shown, after immediate; 864 vanilla events read immediate-saved scopes there (issue #95)
the scope is saved earlier inside the same trigger (issue #96)
the variable is set by an earlier firing of the event, the intended pattern (issue #97)
